findings.evidence: MeasureGGUF calls sampleGGUFTensorValues before meter.charge(bytesNeeded). Successful documents still account reads correctly; no corrupt evidence or measured incident is asserted.
findings.impact: A declared read ceiling fails to bound work on the failure path. No full-store or model benchmark was run.

The 514 scalar comparisons and 56 directions passed bitwise, including guard decisions, normalization multipliers, zero/tiny weights and thresholds around rounded FP32 squared norms. FP64 round-to-nearest scalar instructions were checked despite fast-math compiler options. Twelve alternating pairs across 32 cells compared preservation with reconstruction and counted bandwidth, launches and otherwise-skipped GEMMs. Normal cases ranged from no detectable gain to about 15% faster; every guarded cell was about 105-395% slower. The declared stopping rule rejected the candidate before further full-step/streamed runs. The unchanged production path remains. Optimizer-only gain could have qualified under the frozen 5% minimum, full-step regression and memory limits, but the guard-heavy limit failed. No candidate full-step improvement is claimed.
